ordinary_path_redundancy: runPressure validates bounds/chunk/units, then startPressure repeats those checks and reads units again for surface. For a wet partial cell this reads its state three times.
ordinary_overlap_reachability: Unproven. advance queues only origins absent from searches; tick removes an origin from pressure before direct equalize; deferred invalidation/head-refresh completion finishes before deferring. The new native overlap probe explicitly injects private queued+resident state.
interpretation: The overlap test justifies defensive idempotence and watcher ownership. It does not prove a naturally occurring gameplay leak or explain the basin p95 regression. Normal-path redundant reads are directly reproduced with exact source methods.
